recipe.visualDefinition: A high-key studio portrait of a young woman sitting on a vibrant yellow floor against a matching yellow backdrop. She wears a white sleeveless shift dress with a small floral pattern and white pointed-toe flats. The composition is anchored by bold, multi-layered typography in the upper left quadrant.
coreVisualRelationships: Subject positioned in the lower right, balancing heavy text in the upper left
Monochromatic yellow environment creating a seamless 'infinity' effect
High-contrast dark brown and black text against the bright yellow field
Soft studio lighting casting a distinct shadow to the right of the subject
coreInvariants: Solid bright yellow background and floor
Subject in a seated, slightly reclined pose
Mix of decorative script and heavy slab-serif typography

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Subject occupies the right two-thirds of the frame, seated low to the ground.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The large decorative script of the primary name in the top left.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Starts at the top-left text, moves down through the subtitle, then follows the subject's gaze and body line toward the bottom right.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Extensive yellow negative space surrounding the subject and text blocks.

colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High saturation yellow with high-value white accents and low-value dark text.

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.baseSkeleton: Mix of heavy decorative script and condensed slab-serif
letterConstructionRules: Primary text uses thick, swash-heavy script with high contrast
Secondary text uses a bold, condensed, all-caps slab-serif
Tertiary text is a small, light sans-serif for track listings
characterSpecificRedesigns: Curled terminals on uppercase script letters
Tight letter spacing in the slab-serif block
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: High-contrast pairing of organic, flowing script with rigid, geometric slab-serif.
graphicDevices: Small rectangular logo frame in the middle-left
Horizontal line of metadata text at the extreme bottom

preserve: Left-alignment of the main text block
The specific dark brown color for the script

candidateDirections.reason: Captures the heavy, decorative 60s script feel
Matches the heavy, condensed slab-serif subtitle style

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: A studio photograph of a young woman with a 1960s blonde flip hairstyle, wearing a white floral sleeveless shift dress and white flats, sitting on a bright yellow floor against a seamless bright yellow background. Soft lighting with a shadow cast to the right. Leave the upper left quadrant empty for text.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add the main name in a large dark brown decorative swash script in the top left. Directly below it, add a subtitle in bold black condensed slab-serif all-caps. Add a small block of fine print below that.

verificationChecks: Is the background a single, consistent yellow tone?
Is the script text dark brown rather than black?
Is the subject's pose seated and low to the ground?

adjustableVariables: Floral pattern density on the dress
Specific shade of yellow (from lemon to mustard)
mustRedesign: Any modern digital artifacts or gradients in the background
Modern clothing styles like jeans or t-shirts
postGenerationChecks: Check that the text does not overlap the subject's head.
Ensure the shadow on the floor looks natural and grounded.
Verify the script font has visible swashes on capital letters.
Confirm the yellow color is uniform across the entire background.
recipe.reuseFormula: Studio portrait + Seamless monochromatic background + Left-aligned vintage display typography = Mid-century album aesthetic.
